name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Kuwait site hit 26 Nov; Hormuz tanker strikes
summary: Kuwait says two Italians died in an Iranian drone attack on 26 Nov; Iran's Guards report a tanker hit on 27 Nov
state: Kuwait's defence ministry said two Italian citizens died from falling debris as Iranian drones targeting a vital site were intercepted on 26 Nov; Iran's foreign minister Araghchi denied involvement and called the incident suspicious (The National, Al Jazeera). The same day a projectile hit Saudi Arabia's Jazan refinery, killing a worker, and Iran's Guards said tankers hit mines in Hormuz. Attacks on Gulf states, energy sites and shipping keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and other Gulf states, which can change quickly. Energy and shipping disruption tends to feed through to fuel prices.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states and attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure and shipping = Alert

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran war live: IRGC says tanker hit in Hormuz; Araghchi calls deadly Kuwait attack suspicious

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
